column1: # Final chr2 karyotypes of the 619 analysed individuals. karyotype = full-depth GMM (analysis/steps/03_karyotype/karyotypes.tsv); karyotype_ds = depth-equalised (~1x) GMM (karyotypes_downsampled.tsv). They agree for 601. The 18 disagreements are full-depth AA calls of low-depth or heterozygous individuals captured by a broad AA component, and the final call is the depth-equalised one. AA = 2a/2a, AB = 2a/2+, BB = 2+/2+.
